# Frame.io

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: video-collaboration product and marketing design: a complete declared token layer on one painted dark theme (the 19-step --color-grey-00..100 neutral ramp from #000 field to #fcfcfc ink, five brand hues --color-cobalt/iris/coral/electric/turquoise-triumph with steps, per-hue alpha tints like --color-cobalt-20, the --color-alpha-* ladders, --color-accent, --overlay-* scrims, three font roles --font-main/-secondary/-tertiary, a --spacer-* scale, the --grid-* 12-column/1080px frame, --nav-height, --duration-*/--ease-*, --card-hover-* and a --z-index-* map) behind a dark marketing surface (near-black field, #fcfcfc ink, white CTA pills with near-black ink, translucent-ink hairlines, FrameGothic/NeueMachinaInktrap/Inter self-hosted variable faces), click-opened header mega-menus, a pricing grid with billing toggle and feature-comparison accordions, a contact form, index surfaces for customers/integrations/what's-new, the light accounts.frame.io sign-in card and a 390px pass with the nav overlay.

Captured 2026-11-15, signed out (every captured surface is public; the app and every post-login surface - projects, the review player, Camera to Cloud uploads, Drive and Transfer workspaces, admin, billing - is an authenticated boundary never reached; the accounts.frame.io/welcome sign-in and the /contact/form fields were measured and typed into then cleared, never submitted; every CTA, nav item, menu item and card was measured, never followed; no consent layer appeared for the en-US signed-out visitor and the cookie-preferences control was never pressed; the site ships no theme switch - every frame.io page paints the one dark theme, and accounts.frame.io/welcome is the lone light surface on a different stack). Themes: dark.

A token set and component reference for Frame.io's public surfaces — for building video-collaboration marketing pages, feature pages, pricing grids, resource indexes and the sign-in edge in the style of the real thing. It was read from **frame.io** on **2026-11-15**, and the public tree was walked again on **2026-11-21**, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 x 900 and 390 x 844. Captured: the home page, /features/workflow-management, /features/review-and-approval, /features/c2c, /pricing, /enterprise, /enterprise/media-and-entertainment, /customers, /case-studies/ford, /integrations, /resources, /whats-new, /contact, /contact/form, /security, /ai, /drive and /transfer, plus the header's Features, Enterprise and Resources mega-menus, the 390px nav drawer, 390px passes on home, pricing and the contact form, and the empty sign-in surface at accounts.frame.io/welcome. The 2026-11-21 walk added the open locale list, the annual pricing state, and a fresh empty-wall photograph. See [site-tree.md](site-tree.md).

Frame.io is worth a capture because the whole public site is painted in one dark theme and it ships a real token layer: the marketing Next.js + CSS-modules app declares a 19-step `--color-grey-00..100` neutral ramp (00 the near-black field, 100 the #fcfcfc ink), five brand hues (`--color-cobalt`, `--color-iris`, `--color-coral`, `--color-electric`, `--color-turquoise-triumph`, each with light/dark steps) and per-hue alpha tints (`--color-cobalt-20` is rgba(91,83,255,0.2)), the `--color-alpha-black/dark/light-*` ladders, `--color-accent`, `--overlay-*` scrims, three font roles (`--font-main` FrameGothic, `--font-secondary` NeueMachinaInktrap, `--font-tertiary` Inter — each a self-hosted variable face with an Arial-metric fallback), a `--spacer-*` scale, the `--grid-*`/`--global-max-width` frame (12 columns, 1080px content), `--nav-height` geometry, `--duration-*`/`--ease-*` motion steps, `--card-hover-*` and a `--z-index-*` layer map. **Boundary:** the product — projects, the review player, Camera to Cloud uploads, Drive, Transfer deliveries — sits behind an account and was never reached. The 2026-11-21 walk photographed the welcome wall empty and did not type into it. The contact form stays at rest. Cookie preferences does not open a banner on frame.io. The locale list and the annual billing state were opened.

## Typography

No composite type styles in tokens.json; the README text below names the faces and sizes.

### Fonts (from README.md)

- **FrameGothic** — a 400-600 variable face (`--font-main`): every display heading and button label, with an Arial-metric fallback.
- **NeueMachinaInktrap** (`--font-secondary`) — labels, kickers and the mono-flavoured UI type.
- **Inter** — a 100-900 variable face (`--font-tertiary`): body copy and UI text.
- None is bundled here; the style guide falls back to system faces. Declared in the stylesheet's `@font-face` rules (harvested in `raw/css-vars.json`).

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **The signed-in product.** Projects, the review-and-approval player, Camera to Cloud uploads, Drive and Transfer workspaces need an account this capture does not have. accounts.frame.io/welcome is the sign-in surface — a different styled-components stack that shares none of the marketing `--*` layer; its measured values sit under `component.productShell.*`, honestly labelled.
- **"Dark" naming.** frame.io paints one dark surface and ships no `[data-theme]` scope or toggle; `dark` is the package's only theme set because it is the only painted theme. accounts.frame.io/welcome is the lone light surface — kept as measured component tokens, not a second set.
- **Animated surfaces.** Heroes and product demos hold live canvas/video content; a screenshot freezes one frame. Sparse-looking panels are a capture artifact, not the design.
- **The forms.** The 2026-11-21 walk did not type into the contact form or the welcome email field. Filled crops from the earlier pass were removed. Validation, error, loading and success states are unverified because nothing was submitted.
- **Detail pages.** Customers, integrations, resources and what's-new were captured at index level (plus one case study, Ford); individual stories, articles and integration pages are the same templates, unmeasured.
- **Quantised screenshots.** `screenshots/` are 256-colour PNGs; read exact colours from tokens or the raw values, never the pixels.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do let the declared layer carry the design.** Frame.io ships its tokens: use the `color.grey.*` ramp, the brand hues and the `dark.theme.*` roles rather than restating hex. See [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [home-dark-default](screenshots/home-dark-default.png).
2. **Do keep ink near-white on near-black.** Every public page paints the same dark theme — `--color-grey-00` field, `--color-grey-100` ink, hierarchy through the alpha-light ladder. See [hero-h1](components/crops/hero-h1-default.png).
3. **Do make the CTA a white pill.** The primary action is a 39.75px-high full-radius pill (#f5f5f8 fill, near-black ink) — the inverse of the field, never a brand colour at rest. See [nav-cta](components/crops/nav-cta-default.png) and [hero-cta](components/crops/hero-cta-default.png).
4. **Do pair the three voices.** FrameGothic carries display and control labels, NeueMachinaInktrap the kickers, Inter the body — a three-voice system, not one family at different weights. See [section-h2](components/crops/section-h2-default.png).
5. **Don't style the signed-in product from this package.** The app was never reached; `component.productShell.*` marks the sign-in surface's measurements on a different stack with a different palette. See [welcome-light-default](screenshots/welcome-light-default.png).
6. **Don't invent a light theme.** The site ships no theme switch; `dark` is the only painted set and the welcome page's light scheme belongs to the accounts stack, not to frame.io pages. See [footer](components/crops/footer-default.png).
7. **Don't fabricate form outcomes.** The contact form and the welcome email field were photographed empty. Validation, error and success states are unverified. See [welcome-light-empty-desktop](screenshots/welcome-light-empty-desktop.png).
8. **Don't copy the brand.** The Frame.io waveform mark, integration logos and demo imagery in captures are Frame.io's published artwork; borrow structure and proportion, not identity. See [mkt-logo](components/crops/mkt-logo-default.png).
